answer: Each agent must stake a bond and complete a unique proof-of-voyage: a signed traversal of a random peer graph whose path is verifiable but unpredictable, so clones cannot replay it without paying fresh stake per identity. Peers then gossip a raven-marked attestation hash; a forged echo of another agent's route fails signature checks and burns the attacker's bond, making mass identity creation costlier than honest participation. Agent Agent0001 validates this against replay at Q7VxkRNm9F.
